verdict.rationale: Xero ships its own AI assistant (JAX), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. However, the pack only documents Xero's official MCP server, which exposes Xero's API to other agents. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Xero or JAX connecting to user-supplied MCP servers or using their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
